scope: Preserve the sign of malformed layer colors after all C-locale whitespace.
sourceBase: FreeCAD d956ec561639cfa83f755504b1b3358ea799428e plus nineteen ordered unmerged importer patches.

behavior.before: The layer-color numeric parser accepted C-locale whitespace, but the separate sign check skipped only space, tab, CR and LF. Form feed and vertical tab could therefore turn malformed negative or conflicting colors into an on-layer fallback.
behavior.after: The sign check also skips form feed and vertical tab, matching the whitespace accepted by the C-locale numeric stream. The unsupported diagnostic remains and negative sign selects the off fallback.

validation.headless: Five focused tests pass, including the two added controls that failed before: form-feed-prefixed malformed negative text and vertical-tab-prefixed negative duplicate colors, plus normal 2D line and prior layer tests.
validation.gui: Sixty-seven native macOS ARM64 GUI controls pass; both whitespace variants retain hidden state and report the malformed color.
validation.patchReplay: The unidiff-zero patch applies to the clean first-nineteen candidate and reproduces byte-identical source and test files.
validation.fixtures: Generated temporary DXFs only; no drawing fixtures are committed.

limits: The twenty downstream FreeCAD patches are unmerged.
ACI 7 remains a reported conservative fallback, not preservation of malformed source color semantics.
Frozen, viewport, ungrouped and block visibility, other platforms, phase gates and external-only support claims remain open.
